version: instruments 1 (2026-11-01): instr-design p04 bridges, refit by fit.d_gz_bridges

d_gz.note: quarterly GZ change (pp) = a + b x d(Baa-10y) + c x (the US market quarterly log total return); on a monthly core the same linear map runs month by month (it sums to the quarter). The default is the fitted formula as it stands, the design's D15 default (0.019 + 1.003 d(Baa-10y) - 0.771 r_eq), applied identically to every row, scenario, custom run, view and continuation chunk. Decision of the 2026-11-02 review round (spec default kept): the per-view centring of the equity term (equity_center "core") was withdrawn because it removed every scenario-level equity stress from d_gz (ai_bust, equity 2.9%/yr, widened less than the baseline) and made a row's d_gz depend on the other rows of its view. The formula's own level drift on cores whose market return is below the 1990-2014 mean (about +0.8pp of GZ over 15 years on the baseline, +1.1pp on ai_bust) is part of the bridge and is disclosed. No noise by default: the residual is unrelated to equities and lowers the BDC / MLP correlation with the market further (0.32 -> 0.27).

decisions.2026-11-02: d_gz bridge: the literal spread_eq formula (D15 default) for every view; the per-view equity centring is withdrawn (review finding 2).
